intent.proves: At least one completed order has a captured amount.

bindings.reason: search_orders takes a request object and pages; a complete-enumeration handler with this filter is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomOrders WHERE OrderComplete = 1 AND ISNULL(OrderDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsQuote, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsLedgerEntry, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsRecurringOrderTemplate, 0) = 0 AND OrderCaptureAmount > 0

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
